verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's own site describes it as 'a fast open-source column-oriented database management system,' and its source is published on GitHub (clickhouse-gh-1), confirming public, licensed source access typical of an OSS project. Missing for 10: explicit citation of the license name/text (e.g., Apache-2.0) and independent confirmation of license terms beyond the 'open-source' label.
